entries.title: Psalms 116:1
segments: The goodness of God in hearing and answering prayer lays us under special obligations to love and adore him, and to continue to call upon him as long as we live.

entries.title: Psalms 116:2
segments: Inclined his ear; heard my supplications.

entries.title: Psalms 116:3
segments: Sorrows of death--pains of hell; the anguish occasioned by deadly perils.

entries.title: Psalms 116:6
segments: Simple; those who feel their ignorance and need of divine teaching.

entries.title: Psalms 116:7
segments: Jehovah is the only sure and permanent rest of the soul, and those who reject him will remain restless for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 116:10
segments:
I believed; in the promised faithfulness of God. 
 
  Have I spoken; of the deliverance and preservation which God has vouchsafed to me.
Faith in God as a prayer-hearing and sin-forgiving God, affords great encouragement to continue to call upon him.

entries.title: Psalms 116:11
segments: In my haste; in my dismay occasioned by the sorrows of death and the pains of hell.
Liars; undeserving of my confidence.  In his trouble he turned away from all human help to God.

entries.title: Psalms 116:13
segments: The cup of salvation; which commemorated his deliverance from trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 116:15
segments: The death of God's people, as well as their life, is under his control and an object of his special care.

entries.title: Psalms 116:16
segments: Loosed my bonds; his bonds of affliction.

entries.title: Psalms 116:18
segments: Those who in time of trouble have vowed unto the Lord, shoud be careful when he delivers them to acknowledge him with praise.
